references.fact: KVM_GET_STATS_FD returns a descriptor exposing VM or vCPU statistics.
kvm_vcpu_ioctl_get_stats_fd constructs kvm-vcpu-stats:%d, allocates CLOEXEC descriptor and opens the anonymous file O_RDONLY; file operations are read, release and seek.
QEMU v8.2.2 creates and retains the per-vCPU statistics descriptor during vCPU initialization.

limits: Primary upstream sources explain the interface; not an attestation of exact Ubuntu patched native text. Actual pinned binary and descriptor were observed; no guest cont, device-ioctl refusal or tool denial occurred. The initial failed observation remains unchanged.
